supplementary_materials: available from the corresponding author upon request

metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)

nodes_source.source_quote: The simulation is performed in the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao through a tunnel in Shandong, China
nodes_source.description: Real-world traffic data including 10-min volumes and vehicle behavior parameters from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, used to calibrate a microscopic simulation in SUMO.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability section states data is available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts (xi, yi) coordinates for each vehicle from raw traffic video frames into a position matrix mt of size X by Y. Positions of signal lights are also included as constants UG or UR.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, generic techniques used but not named, most state parameters defined.

nodes_process.source_quote: Since one matrix is insufficient to describe vehicle dynamics, we stack the matrices of consecutive N time steps to represent the state st.
nodes_process.description: Stacks N consecutive position matrices after down-sampling to form a spatiotemporal state representation st.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, required parameters like n_frames are specified, though downsampling details are brief.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network... consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer for each output layer.
nodes_process.description: Defines a dual-output CNN architecture (Multitask learning) for estimating Q-values and predicting speed/queue length simultaneously using ReLU activations.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, architecture is fully specified in Figure 7 and Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: The algorithm for training the ramp metering policy is presented in Algorithm 1.
nodes_process.description: Trains the DQN using Experience Replay and a Target Network with the Adam optimizer. Losses include TD-error and multitask regression error for speed and queue prediction.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, algorithm and nearly all hyperparameters specified.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator.
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the trained agent in SUMO against No-control and PI-ALINEA baselines across 20 simulation experiments with different random seeds.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, simulator named, parameters mostly stated, though specific random seeds are omitted.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Assesses model robustness by removing information from specific spatial subareas (1-8) of the control area.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, procedure defined but specific perturbation details for 'removing information' are brief.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 8: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Shows training progress over 1,000,000 frames, indicating convergence of both episode rewards and mainline travel times.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Training process well-specified with hyperparameters and Algorithm 1; however, raw training logs depend on proprietary traffic data.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9: Vehicle travel times in the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Compares time-series of mainline travel times for three scenarios: No control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Result follows clearly from simulation methodology, but relies on non-public traffic volume data from Qingdao-Huangdao freeway.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2: Mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments (s).
nodes_sink.description: Mean travel time comparisons across 20 independent simulation trials for three control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Numerical findings are well-structured; reproducibility limited only by access to the exact empirical demand profiles.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in (a) no-control; (b) PI-ALINEA; (c) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps representing speed variation across time and freeway distance under different ramp metering strategies.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derivable from simulation state, but spatial mapping specifics from SUMO to heatmap coordinates are minimally described.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11: Queue length at the on-ramp.
nodes_sink.description: Comparison of on-ramp vehicle queue lengths over the simulation period for the three scenarios.
nodes_sink.size_estimate: 1 plot with 3 series and confidence intervals
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Standard metric for ramp metering; results are plausible given the stated control logic and simulation setup.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Correlation analysis showing how queue lengths relate to the red light signal duration ratio.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Post-hoc analysis of simulation data; clear correlation shown but requires aggregation of cycle-by-cycle signal states.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13: Queue length and occupancy for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Time-series comparison showing the correlation (Pearson's rho) between mainline occupancy and ramp queue length.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Supports claims of DRL utilizing more than just local occupancy; depends on extraction of occupancy and queue from SUMO.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots of traffic volume measured downstream of the merging area at 5-minute intervals.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Standard throughput evaluation; inputs are standard SUMO outputs based on the provided parameters.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16: Travel time with perturbed input data.
nodes_sink.description: Ablation study results showing mainline travel time sensitivity when video data from specific road subareas is removed.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure for perturbing input matrices is described; reproducible if same simulator and demand data are used.
